title: Transitive symmetry of tribes
statement: For all nonnegative integers $w,s$, the tribes function on the Boolean cube of dimension $sw$ is transitive under coordinate permutations: for every pair of input coordinates, there is a permutation carrying the first to the second that leaves the function invariant on every input.
